# Design System — Vantage Home Services Campaign Page
*Generated by ui-ux-pro-max skill + Vantage brand override · 2026-06-19*
*Read this file before touching any code. Color/type tokens are locked — do not invent new ones.*

---

## Landing Pattern
- **Pattern:** Lead Magnet + Social Proof–Focused Conversion
- **Primary goal:** Cold traffic → booked 15-min call (or audit form submission as the lower-friction entry)
- **CTA hierarchy:** Primary = "Book a 15-min call" (gold fill, blue text); Secondary = "Get a free website audit" (blue outline or ghost)
- **Form fields:** Max 4 (name, business, website URL, phone) — every extra field costs conversions
- **Proof approach:** No invented testimonials. Use founding-client framing + engineer credibility + BCB page as portfolio sample
- **Section order:** Hero → Problem → Solution → How It Works → Packages → Proof/Risk Reversal → About → FAQ → Final CTA → Footer

## Typography Scale

| Role | Size (mobile → desktop) | Weight | Color |
|---|---|---|---|
| H1 (hero headline) | 2.25rem → 3.5rem | 700 | #003D6B |
| H2 (section headline) | 1.75rem → 2.5rem | 700 | #003D6B |
| H3 (card/sub-headline) | 1.25rem → 1.5rem | 600 | #005696 |
| Body | 1rem (min) | 400 | #333333 |
| Body large | 1.125rem → 1.25rem | 300–400 | #333333 |
| Label / eyebrow | 0.75rem | 600 uppercase | #005696 |
| CTA button text | 1rem | 600 | varies (see buttons) |

- Line height: 1.5–1.75 for body; 1.2–1.35 for headings
- Max line length: 65–75 chars (max-w-prose or ~680px)

---

## Spacing Scale
Uses Tailwind default: 4px base unit (1 = 4px).
- Section padding: py-16 (mobile) → py-24 (desktop)
- Card padding: p-6 → p-8
- Grid gap: gap-6 → gap-8
- Container: max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8

---

## Color Usage Rules

| Token | Permitted uses | NEVER use for |
|---|---|---|
| #005696 | Nav bg, hero section bg/overlay, section accents, links | Full-page backgrounds |
| #003D6B | Footer bg, dark section headers | Inline text in body |
| #D4AF37 GOLD | Primary CTA button fill, price highlights, step numbers | Section fills, decorative borders, secondary buttons |
| #E8E0D0 | Alternating section bg, form section bg | Text, icon fills |
| #C0392B | Error states, form validation only | Decorative use |

## Component Decisions

### Buttons
```
PRIMARY CTA (Book a Call):
  bg: #D4AF37 | text: #003D6B | font-weight: 600
  px-8 py-4 rounded-lg shadow-md
  hover: bg-[#c4a030] transition-colors duration-200
  focus: ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-[#D4AF37]
  
SECONDARY CTA (Free Audit):
  bg: transparent | border: 2px solid #005696 | text: #005696
  px-8 py-4 rounded-lg
  hover: bg-[#005696] text-white transition-colors duration-200
  focus: ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-[#005696]
  
GHOST (footer/nav):
  text: white underline on hover
```

### Cards
```
bg: white | border: 1px solid #E0E0E0 | rounded-xl
shadow: shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
padding: p-6 lg:p-8
cursor-pointer on interactive cards
```

### Form
```
Input: bg-white border border-[#E0E0E0] rounded-lg px-4 py-3
  focus: border-[#005696] ring-1 ring-[#005696] outline-none
  error: border-[#C0392B]
Label: text-sm font-600 text-[#333333] mb-1
Submit button: PRIMARY CTA styles (gold)
```

### Package Cards
```
Standard tier: white bg, border #E0E0E0
ANCHOR tier (Growth $2,500): border-2 border-[#005696], shadow-lg, scale-[1.02] on desktop
  — "Most Popular" badge: bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#003D6B] text-xs font-700
```

## Icons
- **Library:** Lucide (CDN via unpkg or jsDelivr) — SVG inline or img src
- **Never use emojis as icons**
- **Size:** 20px (inline text context), 24px (cards), 32–40px (feature highlights)
- **Color:** #005696 primary, #D4AF37 for step numbers / highlights

---

## Responsive Breakpoints
```
Mobile-first. Test at:
  375px  — iPhone SE / smallest phones (primary target: contractors on job sites)
  768px  — iPad / tablet
  1024px — laptop
  1440px — desktop
  
Tailwind prefixes: sm:768 md:1024 lg:1280 xl:1536
Use the non-prefixed class for mobile, override up.
```

---

## Anti-Patterns for This Niche (DO NOT USE)
- AI purple / pink gradients — screams generic template
- Countdown timers or fake urgency ("Offer expires in 00:12:47!")
- Invented testimonials or stock-photo "contractor" headshots
- Dark mode — contractors on job sites need high-contrast light mode
- Complex multi-level navigation — this is a one-page conversion asset
- Oversized hero images that slow mobile load (use CSS gradients + minimal imagery)
- Jargon ("synergize", "leverage", "solutions") — plumbers don't talk like that
- Any color outside the brand token set (especially: teal, purple, green, warm orange)
- Hidden or small contact info — phone + email must be visible without scrolling

---

## Performance Targets
- Lighthouse Performance ≥ 90 (static HTML + Tailwind CDN + deferred scripts)
- LCP < 2.5s on mobile
- No render-blocking resources above the fold
- Images: max 150KB each, use WebP where possible
- Scripts: async or defer

---

## Pre-Delivery Checklist

### Visual Quality
- [ ] No emojis used as icons (Lucide SVG only)
- [ ] All text in Poppins (not system fallback)
- [ ] Gold (#D4AF37) used ONLY on primary CTA buttons and price highlights
- [ ] No colors outside brand token set
- [ ] Hover states don't cause layout shift

### Interaction
- [ ] All clickable elements have `cursor-pointer`
- [ ] Hover states provide clear visual feedback (150–300ms transition)
- [ ] Focus rings visible on all interactive elements (ring-2 minimum)
- [ ] Tab order matches visual reading order

### Conversion
- [ ] Primary CTA (Book a Call) visible without scrolling on mobile
- [ ] Both CTA paths tested and functional (link to [BOOKING_URL])
- [ ] Audit form submits to n8n webhook `/webhook/landing-page-lead`
- [ ] Phone number and email visible in footer (no scroll required on desktop)
- [ ] No broken links or placeholder text in final delivery

### Accessibility
- [ ] All images have descriptive alt text
- [ ] Form inputs have explicit `<label for="">` associations
- [ ] Color contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for all text (#333 on white = 10.5:1 ✓)
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` media query in CSS
- [ ] Semantic HTML (h1, h2, h3, nav, main, section, footer, article)

### Responsive
- [ ] Tested at 375px — no horizontal scroll, readable, CTAs tappable
- [ ] Tested at 768px
- [ ] Tested at 1024px
- [ ] Tested at 1440px
- [ ] Touch targets ≥ 44x44px

### Meta / SEO
- [ ] `<title>` tag set
- [ ] `<meta name="description">` set
- [ ] Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url)
- [ ] `<link rel="canonical">` set
- [ ] Favicon present
- [ ] `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`

### Analytics / Tracking
- [ ] GA4 / Cloudflare Analytics snippet present (async)
- [ ] CTA click events tracked (data-track attributes or JS listeners)
- [ ] Form submit event tracked
